purpose: Complete the single incomplete S5 condition B unit in P4 Replicate 3 without replaying its other 32 completed units.

treatment.unit_policy: Run one fresh, isolated replacement attempt for exactly B/S5/replicate-3 using the already-frozen P4 method and the same ten-candidate budget.
treatment.original_partial_attempt: Retain all raw records as audit evidence but exclude its nine candidates and decisions from formal metrics.
treatment.replacement_inclusion: Include the supplemental unit only if all ten distinct candidates are generated, all required analyses and confirmations finish, and the existing frozen eligibility rules mark the unit metric-eligible.
treatment.failure_policy: If the supplement remains incomplete or invalid, stop and keep the unit excluded. No automatic retry or second replacement is authorized by this amendment.
treatment.composite_rule: Preserve the 66 previously completed applicable R1-R2 units and 32 completed applicable R3 units. Replace only the missing B/S5/R3 cell in the composite matrix; never combine partial and supplemental candidate sets.

approval_requirement: Separate hash-bound amendment-freeze approval and formal execution approval are required. Existing Replicate-3 approval does not authorize this supplemental execution.
